mechanism: Reverse mandatory <REMOVE> then <REPLACE> order in one otherwise identical E01 local spare replacement task, retaining each type's duration; test native converter rejection.

configuration.positive_control: E01-SURP SEQ1 <REMOVE> ten minutes then SEQ2 <REPLACE> twenty minutes
configuration.invalid_child: E01-SURP SEQ1 <REPLACE> twenty minutes then SEQ2 <REMOVE> ten minutes

hypotheses_to_test: The invalid reversed order imports/exports with exact 20 populated table roundtrip, permitting a converter-level diagnostic.
Native calculation reports at least one explicit conversion error for replacement order and yields no valid simulation output.
Any process exit code of zero does not override converter rejection; no mission behavior is accepted from this child.
Raw artifacts are sealed and GUI/mutex guards hold.
limits: This tests one reversed-order local spare replacement source only; omission, repetition, added custom subtasks and other repair paths are unverified.
GUI-only behavior and cross-engine parity are unverified.
